deploybot: Pipeline started for staging promotion (canary -> staging). Env: staging. Commit: 5d3a1b4. Tag: v2.14.0-rc3. Steps: build -> lint -> unit -> integration -> smoke.

alex_k: noted, preparing release-notes draft.

deploybot: build: SUCCESS — artifact build-5d3a1b4.tar.gz uploaded to artifacts/redwood/builds/5d3a1b4

deploybot: lint: FAILED — 3 problems in repo. Log: https://ci.redwood/logs/2331239876/lint.txt

meera: which rules triggered? quick glance pls.

deploybot: lint errors summary: 
- pkg/runtime/cache.ts: no-unused-vars (line 42)
- server/exec.ts: prefer-const (line 101)
- tools/deploy.ts: import/no-extraneous-dependencies (line 8)

samir: sounds like the eslint-config v5.3 tightened a rule. This RC was built against ^5.3, but main was on 5.2.1 earlier. Could be the cause.

jordan: if lint fails we should NOT promote canary -> staging. Two options: pin eslint-config to 5.2.1 and rerun CI, or fix code. Which is faster?

meera: +1 to pin for the RC path — keep production rules stable. We'll fix upstream later.

alex_k: I can open the pin PR to package.json and request a quick review.

deploybot: unit tests: STARTED

deploybot: unit tests: PASS (98.7%) — 376 tests, 1 slow test (1200ms)

release_bot: Change window check: scheduled change window tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC — still open.

deploybot: integration tests: STARTED

deploybot: integration tests: PASS — 12 suites

deploybot: smoke tests: STARTED

deploybot: smoke tests: FAIL — kv cache timeout on 3/5 endpoints (errors: GET /kv/{key} timeout 500ms)

meera: smoke failures look infra-y. Samir, can you check the node/pod health around the run?

samir: investigating — I see two pod restarts on inference-runtime-2 at 12:31 UTC; kube events show OOMKilled on worker-3. Might explain kv timeouts.

jordan: OK, infra problem blocks promotion regardless. We should not promote. Alex, still do the pin PR so lint stops failing on rerun after infra stabilized.

alex_k: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4124 — pins eslint-config to 5.2.1 and adds a TODO referencing this thread. Requesting @meera for quick approve.

meera: reviewing now. If CI green after pin, we can decide to retry promotion after infra fix.

samir: I'll escalate to eng-infra and ops for node pressure during the window. @ops please advise on capacity/burst plan.

deploybot: CI rerun queued (on PR 4124) after PR merge.

jordan: Decision for now: HOLD staging promotion. Do not promote to canary/staging until PR merged and infra flakiness resolved. We'll re-evaluate in 30m.

alex_k: noted, moving sprint tasks. Will ping when PR merged.

release_bot: Noting this on the release tracker: RC v2.14.0-rc3 paused due to lint + infra.

meera: thanks all — follow-ups: (1) samir escalate infra, (2) alex open PR (done), (3) reconvene in 30m for go/no-go.

jordan: :thumbsup:
